Traditional platforms like PayPal and Stripe provide user-friendly interfaces along with integrated payment processing but impose geographical restrictions that hinder access for creators in Nigeria. On the other hand, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, delivers a complete solution that encompasses hosting, payment processing, and product delivery without geographic limitations. This means that while PayPal may offer streamlined services, it lacks accessibility for many creators, whereas COREMERCH ensures that anyone can set up their online store without being blocked by location.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

PayPal and Stripe operate in only 46 countries, leaving vast regions, including Nigeria, without access. This exclusion creates a reliance on local payment methods that can be unreliable. Conversely, sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH is designed specifically for creators in restricted countries. By using blockchain technology and cryptocurrency payment options, COREMERCH provides a dependable alternative that ensures creators can sell their digital products without being subjected to arbitrary restrictions or account suspensions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

While PayPal boasts quick transactions, the potential for account suspension means that funds can be held for up to 180 days, making it a risky choice for creators. On the other hand, sovereign systems like NOWPayments, integrated into the COREMERCH framework, offer low transaction fees (0.5%) and immediate payment confirmations on-chain. This architecture provides not only speed but also transparency in costs, allowing creators to keep more of their earnings without worrying about hidden fees that often accompany traditional platforms.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures you own everything — no more third-party dependencies.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor when evaluating online selling platforms. With PayPal or Gumroad, creators are subject to the whims of these services, risking account freezes or data access loss. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure ensures that creators own everything — from their data to their product delivery systems. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack allows for automated fulfillment through tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, empowering creators to focus on their products without the fear of losing access to their own business infrastructure.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For those in Nigeria looking to sell ebooks or other digital products, the decision boils down to either accepting the limitations of conventional platforms or embracing a robust sovereign commerce solution. The Edge Commerce Stack provides everything needed to launch and operate an online store independently, without the restrictions of PayPal or Stripe. This architecture allows you to sell freely, keep your data secure, and maintain full control over your operations, making it the clear choice for creators unwilling to compromise on their sovereignty.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid the risk of account suspensions with a self-sufficient digital commerce stack.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
